units: <cite ref="Berakhot 7a:25">Ber. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>מפני מה … ורע לו</he> why is there a righteous man who fares well, and another righteous man who fares badly? <cite ref="Berakhot 23a:7">Ib. 23ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 4:17">Koh. IV, 17</cite>) <he>בין טוב לרע וכ׳</he> they cannot distinguish between good and evil, and want to offer a sacrifice before me? <cite ref="Kiddushin 40a:10">Kidd. 40ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 3:11">Is. III, 11</cite>) <he>וכי יש רשע רע ויש שאינו רע</he> is there a bad wicked man and a wicked man that is not bad?; <he>רע לשמים ורע לבריות וכ׳</he> one bad in his relation to heaven (irreligious) and bad to men is a bad wicked man &c. Ohol. XVIII, 6 <he>שכחן רע</he> whose strength is feeble, v. <cite ref="K00450"><he>כֹּחַ</he></cite>.
Ab. II, 9 חבר רע a bad companion; לב רע a bad heart; a. v. fr.—Fem. רָעָה bad; (noun) evil.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:9">Ib.</cite>, a. fr. <he>עין ר׳</he>, v. <cite ref="P00601"><he>עַיִן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 11a:4">Sabb. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>כל ד׳ ולא אשה ר׳</he> any evil, only not a bad wife.
<cite ref="Berakhot 61a:21">Ber. 61ᵃ</cite> <he>אחת … ואחת יועצתו לר׳</he> one (kidney) counsels for good, the other for evil.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 1:1:6">Y. Shek. I, beg. 45ᵈ</cite> <he>לטובה … לר׳ וכ׳</he> for a good purpose—‘every liberal-hearted’ (<cite ref="Exodus 35:22">Ex. XXXV, 22</cite>) , for a bad purpose—‘the whole people’ (ib. XXXII, 3).

<cite ref="Horayot 10b:17">Hor. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>אפי׳ טובתם … ר׳ היא וכ׳</he> even the good which wicked men do is an evil with the righteous (they do not enjoy it); <cite ref="Yevamot 103a">Yeb. 103ᵃ</cite> sq.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 5:12">Koh. R. to V, 12</cite>, v. <cite ref="H00334"><he>חוֹלָה</he> I</cite>. Ber. l. c. (ref. to <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 4:17">Koh. IV, 17</cite>) <he>אל תהי … אם על ר׳ הם מביאים</he> be not like the fools who sin and offer a sacrifice, not knowing whether they offer it for the good they have done or for the evil; a. v. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="T00904"><he>רָעִים</he></cite>; <he>רָעוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Ketubot 110b:5">Keth. 110ᵇ</cite> (quot. fr. Ben Sira) <he>כל ימי עני ר׳</he> all the days of a poor man are bad; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 101a:2">Snh. 101ᵃ</cite>. Y. Ber. V, 8ᵈ bot., v. <cite ref="H01531"><he>חָצַף</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 42:5">Ex. R. s. 42</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Jeremiah 2:13">Jer. II, 13</cite>) <he>ושתי ר׳ עשו לבד</he> have they committed no more than two evils?; a. v. fr.
